comments.author: @LifeBeatIntoMe
comments.text: Plenty of people from Suriname and neighboring Guyana live in the Netherlands.  Many for several generations already.  We call them "Surinamers".  Very good coffee.  Why so much overhead footage and not actual within the cities, towns, people?

replies.author: @PrimeTravel2
replies.text:
Thank you for your comment! 😊 Suriname has a fascinating connection with the Netherlands, especially because so many Surinamese have lived there for generations.

And I totally understand your point about the aerial footage. We use it to show the incredible scale and nature of Suriname, but you're right — the cities, towns, and everyday life are just as important. Thanks for the feedback! 🙏

comments.author: @maranatha937
comments.text: Yes, but I think I’d need some time to adjust 😅 The forest, the culture and the slower pace of life would be amazing though.

replies.author: @PrimeTravel2
replies.text: Haha, I totally get that! 😅 The slower pace definitely takes some getting used to, but the nature and culture make it pretty special. 🌿😊
